lessonTitle: 31. The tangent to the graph of a function
lessonTitleEnglish: The tangent to the graph of a function
unit: Algebra · Chapter 5. Continuity and the derivative
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: f'(x₀) is the slope of the tangent to the graph at x₀: k = tg α = f'(x₀).
stages.headlineEnglish: f'(x₀) is the slope of the tangent to the graph at x₀: k = tg α = f'(x₀).

stages.headline: The equation of the tangent: y = f(x₀) + f'(x₀)(x − x₀).
stages.headlineEnglish: The equation of the tangent: y = f(x₀) + f'(x₀)(x − x₀).

stages.headline: Example: the tangent to y = x² at x₀ = 1: f(1) = 1, f'(1) = 2, y = 1 + 2(x − 1) = 2x − 1.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: the tangent to y = x² at x₀ = 1: f(1) = 1, f'(1) = 2, y = 1 + 2(x − 1) = 2x − 1.
